content.description:
Upgradable 3D animated robots. 85 Types with a goal to reach 100 types of Cyberbots. Each one with a separate theme and special parts.

All of them have a possibility of being upgraded with various parts from other Cyberbots. Staking Cyberbots and earning rewards when holders upgrade with parts from the staked Cyberbot.
